title: Your comfort zone is a cage built by your own fears. ⛓️ Read that again.
paragraphs: Your comfort zone is a cage built by your own fears. ⛓️ Read that again.

Every time you back down from a challenge, you aren't staying safe—you are building the walls thicker around your potential. The enemy doesn't need to attack you if he can just convince you to stay paralyzed behind the gates of opportunity.
It’s time to stop being a prisoner of "what if" and become a warrior of "even if." Armor up. The breakthrough is on the other side of the fear you are avoiding.
⚔️ “For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind.” - 2 Timothy 1:7
Are you ready to break down some walls today?
